title: Eye of the Beast
description: A large stylized eye with a teal iris and black paw print pupil dominates the upper composition. Paint drips in multiple colors flow downward from the eye into a surreal landscape filled with flowers, roots, smaller eyes, a turtle, and a stream of paw prints cascading from a paint tube on the right.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork featuring a giant stylized eye with a bright teal iris and a black dog paw print as the pupil. Colorful paint drips flow down from the eye. A paint tube on the right pours a stream of glowing paw prints into a dark landscape below filled with white roots, flowers, smaller floating eyes, and a small turtle. Dark background with dripping paint effects across the top.
